standardClauses.text:
The Provider retains all right, title, and interest in and to the Service, the Documentation, and all Provider Materials, including all intellectual property rights therein. No rights are granted to the Customer other than as expressly set forth in this Agreement.

To the extent the Customer or any Authorized User provides suggestions, ideas, enhancement requests, feedback, or recommendations regarding the Service ("Feedback"), the Customer hereby grants the Provider a royalty-free, worldwide, irrevocable, perpetual license to use and incorporate such Feedback into the Service and Provider Materials without restriction or obligation.

standardClauses.title: Service Availability and Maintenance
standardClauses.text:
The Provider shall use commercially reasonable efforts to make the Service available in accordance with the uptime commitment specified in this Agreement.

(a) Scheduled Maintenance: The Provider may perform scheduled maintenance during designated maintenance windows. The Provider shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide at least forty-eight (48) hours' advance notice of scheduled maintenance that may affect Service availability.

(b) Emergency Maintenance: The Provider may perform emergency maintenance at any time to address critical security vulnerabilities, data integrity issues, or other conditions that pose an imminent risk. The Provider shall notify the Customer as soon as reasonably practicable of any emergency maintenance.

(c) Exclusions: Downtime resulting from scheduled maintenance, emergency maintenance, force majeure events, or the Customer's acts or omissions shall not be counted against the uptime commitment.

generalProvisions.title: Entire Agreement
generalProvisions.text: This Agreement, together with all Order Forms and exhibits, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, warranties, commitments, offers, and agreements, whether written or oral.

generalProvisions.title: Amendments
generalProvisions.text: This Agreement may not be amended, modified, or supplemented except by a written instrument signed by both parties.

generalProvisions.title: Severability
generalProvisions.text: If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect, and the invalid provision shall be modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it valid and enforceable.

generalProvisions.title: Waiver
generalProvisions.text: No failure or delay by either party in exercising any right under this Agreement shall operate as a waiver thereof, nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right preclude any further exercise of that or any other right.

generalProvisions.title: Notices
generalProvisions.text: All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed given: (a) when delivered personally; (b) when sent by confirmed electronic mail; (c) one (1) business day after being sent by internationally recognized overnight courier; or (d) three (3) business days after being mailed by registered or certified mail, postage prepaid, to the parties at their respective addresses set forth above.

generalProvisions.title: Assignment
generalProvisions.text: Neither party may assign or transfer this Agreement or any of its rights or obligations hereunder without the prior written consent of the other party, except that either party may assign this Agreement to an Affiliate or in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, provided the assignee assumes all obligations under this Agreement.

generalProvisions.title: Survival
generalProvisions.text: The provisions of this Agreement relating to intellectual property, confidentiality, limitation of liability, indemnification, data protection, and any provisions that by their nature are intended to survive, shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement.

generalProvisions.title: Counterparts
generalProvisions.text: This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Electronic signatures shall be deemed original signatures for all purposes.

CALIFORNIA.title: California-Specific Provisions
CALIFORNIA.text:
(a) Auto-Renewal Disclosure: In accordance with the California Automatic Renewal Law (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §17601–17606), the Provider shall: (i) present the auto-renewal terms in a clear and conspicuous manner before the Customer completes any purchase; (ii) provide an acknowledgment that includes the auto-renewal terms, cancellation policy, and information regarding how to cancel; (iii) provide a mechanism for the Customer to cancel that is accessible online.

(b) Jury Waiver: EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, ALL RIGHTS TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION, PROCEEDING, OR COUNTERCLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT.

(c) CCPA/CPRA: To the extent that the Provider processes personal information (as defined under Cal. Civ. Code §1798.100 et seq.) on behalf of the Customer, the Provider shall act as a "Service Provider" and shall comply with all applicable requirements of the California Consumer Privacy Act and the California Privacy Rights Act, including the restrictions set forth in Cal. Civ. Code §1798.140(ag).

ENGLAND_WALES.title: England & Wales-Specific Provisions
ENGLAND_WALES.text:
(a) Third Party Rights: No person who is not a party to this Agreement shall have any rights under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce any term of this Agreement.

(b) Non-Excludable Liability: Nothing in this Agreement shall exclude or limit liability for: (i) fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation; (ii) death or personal injury caused by negligence; or (iii) any other liability that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law.

(c) Consumer Rights: To the extent applicable, nothing in this Agreement shall affect the Customer's statutory rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015.

(d) UK GDPR: To the extent that the Provider processes personal data (as defined under the UK General Data Protection Regulation and the Data Protection Act 2018) on behalf of the Customer, the Provider shall act as a "processor" and both parties shall comply with all applicable data protection requirements. The parties agree to enter into a Data Processing Agreement that complies with Article 28 of the UK GDPR.

SPAIN.title: Spain-Specific Provisions (Disposiciones Específicas para España)
SPAIN.text:
(a) LSSI-CE: The Provider shall comply with the Ley 34/2002 de Servicios de la Sociedad de la Información y de Comercio Electrónico (LSSI-CE), including the obligations regarding commercial communications and information duties.

(b) Good Faith: This Agreement shall be interpreted and performed in accordance with the principle of good faith (buena fe) as set forth in Articles 7 and 1258 of the Código Civil.

(c) Interpretation: In the event of any ambiguity, this Agreement shall be interpreted in accordance with the rules of interpretation set forth in Articles 1281 through 1289 of the Código Civil.

(d) GDPR/LOPDGDD: To the extent that the Provider processes personal data on behalf of the Customer, the Provider shall act as an "encargado del tratamiento" and both parties shall comply with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) and the Ley Orgánica 3/2018 de Protección de Datos Personales y garantía de los derechos digitales (LOPDGDD). The parties agree to enter into a Data Processing Agreement (Acuerdo de Tratamiento de Datos) that complies with Article 28 of the GDPR.
